item.description: JetBlue is ending its direct flights between New York's JFK Airport and Vero Beach Regional Airport, citing low passenger demand for the route that launched in December. item.title: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County return home after 2-year evacuation
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of being displaced from their condos due to structural damage.

item.title: Security First Insurance lowers Florida homeowners rates by 5.6%, adds disappearing deductible
item.description: Security First Insurance is lowering homeowners insurance rates by an average of 5.6% and launching a disappearing deductible program for its 155,000 Florida policyholders.

item.description: Three young gymnasts from Flip City Gym and Cheer secured a top 15 finish at AAU Nationals in Knoxville, Tennessee last month, qualifying them for the Junior Olympics in Iowa next month. item.title: Argentina rallies past England 2-1 to reach World Cup final with late goals from Fernandez and Martinez
item.description: Defending champion Argentina came back from a 1-0 deficit with two late goals to defeat England 2-1 in the World Cup semifinals Wednesday. Argentina will face Spain in the final Sunday in East Rutherford, New Jersey.

item.description:

item.title: Florida Man Loses Roof to Hurricane Milton Two Months After Paying Off Home, Faces Repairs Without Insurance
item.description: A Florida homeowner paid off his house only to have Hurricane Milton tear off his roof two months later, leaving him to cover repair costs without insurance.

item.title: Villa Del Sol residents return home in St. Lucie County after nearly 2 years following structural damage evacuation
item.description: Villa Del Sol residents in St. Lucie County are returning home after nearly two years of displacement from their condos. Residents were notified last month they could return to their condos after an inspection in August 2024 found structural damage in buildings 3, 4, and 5, which were deemed unsafe.

item.title: Port St. Lucie Opens Registration for Free City University Program
item.description:
Registration is now open for Port St. Lucie City University, a free nine-session program designed to help residents better understand how their local government operates.
